m3b_processed_sample.meaning: a row read verbatim from the frozen M3B source_train/source_dev parquet -- already face-cropped/preprocessed by the frozen Version-C pipeline

siw_raw_video.meaning: a raw SiW-Mv2 video from the exact local permitted population -- NOT yet face-preprocessed; requires the frozen Version-C SCRFD/face-crop pipeline before any detector training can use it
siw_raw_video.why: SiWMv2Adapter carries no canonical subject mapping in this exact local release; per the E7A_SIW_LOCAL_ONLY_AMENDMENT.json amendment, no subject_id is ever fabricated from a filename or otherwise

fold_identity_formula: sha256(canonical_json({fold_id, source_domains (sorted), target_domain, source_train_reference_identity, source_dev_reference_identity, siw_population_identity, siw_split_identity, m3b_package_identity, target_reference_identity}))
downstream_phase_owns: the frozen Version-C face-preprocessing pipeline must be run (a LATER phase, not E7-A) on every siw_raw_video reference before it can enter detector training; E7-A's materialized output is a REFERENCE manifest, never pixel data
atomicity: each FOLD_MATERIALIZATION.json is written to a .tmp sibling and Path.replace()'d into place -- atomic on POSIX
resume_policy: identical fold_identity on a pre-existing materialization -> resume-safe (no rewrite, ALREADY_MATERIALIZED_MATCH); differing fold_identity -> E7AMaterializationConflict, FAIL CLOSED, never silently overwritten
